platforms.name: Revealed Recordings Account-Gated Demo Upload Route
platforms.country: Netherlands / Breda global electronic and mainstage label
platforms.feeAmount: No mandatory demo-submission fee was confirmed from the public demo landing flow; the wider platform exposes separate Pro and credit products, so any live demo-credit requirement must be checked manually.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Revealed Recordings exposes Upload Demo in its official navigation, but opening the route redirects to an email/password login page with account creation and an optional Spotify connection. A human must review account terms, any demo-credit or Pro boundary, public/private visibility, ownership, master status, metadata, permitted audio delivery and all live declarations before upload.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from the official Revealed Recordings site and demo-login flow. The site displays a large active catalogue, 2026-dated offers and current label content. The footer also exposes account, credit and Pro areas, but no payment was confirmed as mandatory for demo submission. No account was created or accessed, no Spotify authorization was granted, no credits were bought, no file or link was supplied, no cookie preference was changed and no CAPTCHA or anti-bot control was handled.

platforms.name: Protocol Recordings Exclusive LabelRadar Demo Drop Route
platforms.country: Netherlands / Amsterdam global electronic and progressive-house label
platforms.feeAmount: No demo-submission fee is stated on Protocol Recordings' official demo page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Protocol Recordings accepts unsigned productions only through its embedded widget or official LabelRadar link. It excludes bootlegs, mash-ups and promos, requires the demo to be offered exclusively to Protocol, asks artists not to submit twice and states that interest will be communicated within 30 days. A human must approve the exclusivity window, LabelRadar account or session, rights, master, metadata, link or upload settings and all live platform terms.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from Protocol Recordings' official homepage, demo page and contact page. The site shows active current releases and news. The contact page publishes licensing and press-related business addresses but explicitly directs demos to the submission form; those business addresses were not used as alternatives. No LabelRadar account or widget was used, no demo was delivered, no form was submitted, no payment was started and no anti-bot control was handled.

platforms.name: Armada Music Official Dynamic Demo Drop Route
platforms.country: Netherlands / Amsterdam global dance, house and trance label group
platforms.feeAmount: No mandatory demo fee or payment requirement is stated on Armada Music's public homepage.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Armada Music exposes a dedicated Demo drop destination in the official site navigation. The public static view does not reveal the complete rendered field set, file or private-link requirements, label selection, rights declarations, login state, CAPTCHA state or any runtime pricing boundary. A human must open the live workflow and approve every field, term, ownership statement, master and metadata requirement before submission.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from Armada Music's official homepage, which carries a 2026 copyright notice, a dedicated Demo drop navigation item and current featured releases including a 2026 anthem. No dynamic demo workflow was completed, no account or authentication was used, no file or link was supplied, no payment was initiated, no cookie choice was made and no CAPTCHA or anti-bot control was handled. No business email was guessed or substituted.

platforms.name: Ninja Tune Direct Digital Demo Email Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / London global independent electronic, downtempo, experimental and hip-hop label group
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated in Ninja Tune's official demo policy.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Ninja Tune's official demo policy accepts digital demos at demos@ninjatune.net using links to MP3 files, SoundCloud pages or websites, explicitly forbids MP3 email attachments, asks for contact details in the email body, requests a short submission with the best tracks first and says not to chase for a response. A human must select appropriate tracks, verify rights and link permissions, prepare concise metadata and ensure no prohibited attachment is included.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from Ninja Tune's official contact/demo-policy page and current 2026 releases catalogue. The official page also publishes separate shop, press and licensing addresses, which were classified by purpose and not used for demos. No email was sent, no link or audio was delivered, no attachment was prepared, no account was used and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.

platforms.name: Anjunabeats General Contact Pre-Submission Routing Inquiry
platforms.country: United Kingdom / London global trance, progressive and melodic electronic label
platforms.feeAmount: No fee or payment requirement is stated for the official general contact form.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Anjunabeats publishes an official contact form, but its visible topic list does not include demos or unsolicited music. This record is therefore limited to a short asset-free General-topic inquiry asking whether the label currently accepts external demos and which authorized route applies. A human must inspect the live form, avoid attaching or linking music, respect any runtime verification and stop if the form or response says unsolicited submissions are not accepted.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from the official Anjunabeats homepage and contact page. The site is active with current releases, Anjunabeats Volume 17 and ABGT700 scheduled for September 11-13, 2026. No form was submitted, no music, files or links were included, no contact address was inferred, no account was used and no CAPTCHA or anti-bot mechanism was handled.
